Description: Establish the app workspace database configuration UI system and API conventions.
Implement student signup secure sessions editable profiles and role-specific access.
Create publish discover and manage free campus events.
Enforce duplicate-safe registration capacity limits cancellation and private attendance passes.
Authorise check-in and generate attendee-only PDF certificates.
Provide role-specific student organiser and volunteer dashboards.
Deliver lifecycle emails through optional configured SMTP and in-app notices.
Provide privileged account management audit and platform metrics.
Collect attendance-eligible feedback and authorised aggregates/exports.
Prove role boundaries data integrity accessibility and key API flows.
Document environment setup deployment preparation and Jira workflow.

Summary: Run the React and API workspace
Description: As a developer I can install run test and build from the documented root commands. Acceptance: npm install resolves both workspaces; npm run dev starts services; npm test and npm run build work.

Summary: Student and volunteer signup and login
Description: As a student or volunteer I can create my account and sign in. Acceptance: public signup can create only student or volunteer accounts; organiser/admin roles cannot be self-selected; passwords are hashed; invalid login is generic.

Summary: Seed organiser volunteer and demo accounts
Description: As a demo operator I can create role-specific accounts using unique local passwords. Acceptance: seed creates student organiser volunteer administrator and fictional free events; passwords are not logged.

Summary: View and edit my account profile
Description: As a signed-in user I can view my name email role and profile details in My space. Acceptance: name department and student year update only for the current account.

Summary: Create and publish a free event
Description: As an organiser I can create and publish a free campus event. Acceptance: API validates event data and does not accept a payable fee.
As a student I can search filter and inspect public future events. Acceptance: only published future events are listed; category/date filters and pagination work.

Summary: Register for a free event safely
Description: As a student I can reserve a seat. Acceptance: duplicate registration is rejected; atomic capacity never oversells; confirmed registration receives a private pass.
As a student I can cancel before an event starts. Acceptance: cancellation releases one seat once and removes the attendee's pass.
As event staff I can validate an attendee pass. Acceptance: only owner admin or accepted event volunteer can check in; invalid or repeated passes are rejected.

Summary: Generate and download an attendance certificate
Description: As a checked-in attendee I can download my PDF certificate. Acceptance: only the attendee can download a certificate for their own checked-in registration.
As a student I can see my registrations passes status certificates and recent updates. Acceptance: no other student's data is exposed.

Summary: Manage event roster and CSV export
Description: As an organiser I can manage my roster. Acceptance: owner check is enforced; exported fields are limited; spreadsheet formula prefixes are neutralised.
As a volunteer I can apply once and track my application. Acceptance: owner can accept decline and set duty/shift; only accepted volunteers can check in.

As an organiser I can review applicants for an event I own. Acceptance: applicant name/email and role interest are visible; organiser can accept/decline and set duty/shift; accepted volunteers can check in.

As a user I receive welcome registration cancellation volunteer-status and attendance-certificate emails when SMTP is configured. Acceptance: delivery failures are reported without losing the underlying app action.
As an administrator I can change roles or suspend accounts. Acceptance: admin-only endpoints; self-suspension is rejected; changes are audited; password hashes never leave the API.
As an attendee I can rate an event once. Acceptance: only checked-in registration may submit a 1-5 rating; organiser sees an owned-event aggregate.
As the engineering team we can verify auth capacity ownership cancellation attendance certificates and feedback against test-only database state.
As a user I can navigate on mobile and by keyboard. Acceptance: visible focus labels contrast responsive layout and reduced-motion behavior are verified.

Summary: Document setup SMTP and Jira import
Description: As an operator I can configure MongoDB sessions and optional SMTP and import the backlog. Acceptance: env variables and field mapping are documented; no secrets are committed.
As an operator I can verify a staging release. Acceptance: HTTPS same-origin API routing CORS secrets database SMTP and health checks are validated before launch.
